feed.description: I'm looking for a seasoned Amazon expert to fully optimize my brand's listings. This is for Dolca Slim, and I need someone who can handle both the strategy and the visual execution. Scope of work: Optimize 5 listings across 3 SKUs (titles, bullets, descriptions) Keyword research + backend search term optimization (relevant, high-intent, low-waste) A+ Content design — this is a priority; I want strong graphics, not templates Product image optimization / infographics (hero, lifestyle, feature callouts, comparison) Brand Store design and layout You're a strong fit if you have: A proven track record optimizing listings that ranked and converted (send examples) Real graphic design skill for A+ modules and image stacks, not just copy Command of Amazon keyword tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, etc.) Brand Store build experience To apply, please include: 2–3 before/after examples of listings or A+ Content you've designed A one-line note on your approach to keyword research Your timeline and rate for a project of this size Consistency matters — all 5 listings and the Store should feel like one cohesive brand. If that's your strength, I'd like to see your work.

siblingJobs.title: Meta Ads Media Buyer + Creative Strategist (Full-Funnel DTC — Food/CPG)
siblingJobs.description: Overview We're a DTC food brand looking for one person who can own paid social end-to-end — not just push buttons in Ads Manager. You'll build the creative strategy, direct/edit the assets, work with UGC creators, and manage the ad account against real revenue targets. If you're a media buyer who "needs creative handed to you," this isn't the role. If you're an editor who doesn't understand CAC, also not the role. What you'll own Meta Ads account management: structure, budget allocation, scaling, testing cadence Creative strategy: hooks, angles, offers, and a testing roadmap tied to performance data Scripting: writing ad scripts for UGC, static, and direct-response video Video editing: cutting winning assets, iterating on top performers, rapid variation testing Creator management: sourcing, briefing, and reviewing UGC creators Data analysis: reading blended metrics (not just in-platform ROAS), reporting on what's working and why Landing page / offer feedback where it impacts conversion Requirements 3+ years running Meta Ads with meaningful spend (please state your typical monthly budget managed) Proven experience in DTC ecommerce, ideally food/beverage/CPG Strong video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar) — you can turn a raw creator clip into a scroll-stopping ad Comfortable with Shopify analytics, and blended CAC/MER, not just platform-reported ROAS Self-directed. You bring ideas, we don't hand you a task list. Nice to have Experience with AI-generated creative Klaviyo / email-paid coordination Experience launching a brand from low spend to scale To apply, include Two ad accounts you've scaled — spend, ROAS/CAC, timeframe, and what you specifically changed 2–3 video ads you personally edited and scripted (links) One paragraph: your creative testing process — how you decide what to test next Your rate structure (hourly, monthly retainer, or hybrid) and availability Start with: the word "Cane" at the top of your proposal so I know you read this. Generic proposals will be ignored.

pastJobsText.title: TikTok Shop Affiliate Manager — Recruit Creators & Drive Sales (Approved Shop, Ready to Launch)
pastJobsText.description: We have a fully approved and set-up TikTok Shop for a consumer packaged goods brand (better-for-you food product). Everything on the backend is ready. We need someone who knows how to build and manage an affiliate/creator program to drive real sales. What we need help with: Recruiting relevant TikTok affiliates and creators (target audience: women 28-42, health-aware, home bakers) Setting up and managing our affiliate program (open collaboration, target invites, commission structure) Outreach to creators and negotiating partnerships Sending product samples and coordinating content Optimizing our shop listings for conversion Tracking performance and scaling what works You should have: Proven TikTok Shop affiliate program experience (please share results/case studies) Experience recruiting creators at volume Familiarity with TikTok Shop Seller Center and affiliate tools CPG/food & beverage experience is a plus To apply, please tell us: Shops you've managed and the results (GMV, number of active affiliates, sales lift) Your approach to recruiting affiliates for a brand-new shop with no reviews yet

pastJobsText.title: Social Media Content Creator & Manager – Food/Wellness Brand (AI Tools Required)
pastJobsText.description: Social Media Content Creator & Manager – Food/Wellness Brand (AI Tools Required) About Dolca Dolca is a prebiotic cane sugar brand. We help health-conscious consumers enjoy sweetness without compromising gut health. We need someone who can make our social presence as strong as our product. What You'll Do Create scroll-stopping images and short-form videos for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Pinterest Use AI image generation tools (Midjourney, DALL-E, Firefly, or similar) to produce high-quality visuals efficiently Post content on a consistent schedule across all channels Adapt content formats for each platform (what works on TikTok ≠ Pinterest) Light copywriting for captions and hooks Requirements Proven experience creating content for food, beverage, wellness, or CPG brands Proficiency with AI image generation tools – show us examples Video editing skills for short-form content (CapCut, Premiere, or similar) Understanding of what performs on each platform, not just cross-posting the same thing everywhere Reliable, communicative, meets deadlines without chasing To Apply Link to portfolio or examples of social content you've created Show at least 2-3 AI-generated images you've made Tell us which platform you think is highest priority for a prebiotic sugar brand and why (one paragraph, we'll know immediately if you're just copy-pasting applications)

pastJobsText.title: Email Marketing Specialist for Food E-Commerce Brand (Klaviyo)
pastJobsText.description: We're looking for an experienced email marketer to build and manage email flows and campaigns for Dolca, a prebiotic cane sugar brand in the health/wellness CPG space. Scope: Flows: - Welcome series - Abandoned cart / browse abandonment - Post-purchase education sequence - Replenishment reminders (segmented by use case — see below) - Winback sequence Campaigns: - Educational content (gut health benefits, usage tips, recipes, coffee rituals, baking) - Product updates and promotions Quiz Integration & Segmentation: - Help implement or integrate a quiz (Octane AI, Typeform, or similar) to identify how customers plan to use the product - Segment customers by use case: daily coffee sweetener vs. baking vs. mixed use Retention Focus: - Build a post-purchase journey that educates, reinforces the habit, and nudges reorders at the right time for each segment - Recommend quiz questions that capture useful data without friction Requirements: - Proven Klaviyo experience with DTC/e-commerce brands - Experience with quiz tools and segmentation strategies - Strong copywriting, conversational, benefit-driven, not clinical - Experience building retention and repeat purchase flows - Understanding of health/wellness or food & beverage positioning Nice to have: - Experience with gut health, functional foods, or consumable products - Has built quiz-to-email flows before To apply: Share 2-3 examples of email flows or segmentation strategies you've built. Bonus if you've worked with quizzes for personalization. Briefly describe how you'd approach segmenting customers by use case and tailoring replenishment timing.

pastJobsText.title: California Business Lawyer Needed to Review Demand Letter and Assist with Debt Collection
pastJobsText.description: We are seeking a licensed California attorney experienced in business contract law and debt collection to help us recover a past due balance from a client based in California. What We Need Help With: 1. Review and finalize our drafted demand letter for legal accuracy and effectiveness. 2. Issue the letter on your legal letterhead and send it via certified mail and email. 3. Advise us on next steps, including filing a lawsuit if the client does not respond. 4. Handle any legal filing or proceedings required in California Superior Court (optional if you’re litigation-capable or can refer). ⸻ Requirements: • Licensed attorney in California • Experience with breach of contract and commercial debt collection • Ability to issue formal communication on your law firm letterhead • Strong communication and fast turnaround (ideally within 1–2 business days) ⸻ Project Type: One-time project (with possible follow-up for litigation if client fails to pay) ⸻ Budget: Open to proposals — please provide your flat fee or hourly rate for the review and letter issuance. Bonus if you offer a package for further action if needed. ⸻ To Apply: Please include: • Your California Bar license number • A brief description of your relevant experience • Turnaround time • Your proposed fee

pastJobsText.title: Pouch Packaging Designer for Premium Panela Sugar Brand
pastJobsText.description: We are looking for an experienced Pouch Packaging Designer to help us create a premium, eye-catching, and functional packaging design for our Panela Sugar brand. The design should appeal to both retail and wholesale buyers, reflecting the high quality and organic nature of our product. If you have experience designing food-grade pouches and understand compliance, materials, and branding for grocery stores, we’d love to work with you! Project Scope: ✔️ Design a stand-up pouch bag (resealable) for Panela Sugar ✔️ Create a professional and unique layout that is market-ready ✔️ Incorporate branding elements (logo, colors, fonts) ✔️ Ensure compliance with food packaging regulations (FDA, barcode, nutrition facts, expiration date, etc.) ✔️ Prepare print-ready files with correct dielines & specifications ✔️ Provide mockups for marketing & presentations Requirements: 🔹 Proven experience in food packaging design (Portfolio required) 🔹 Experience in flexible packaging, stand-up pouches, or similar food packaging 🔹 Ability to suggest materials, finishes, and textures (matte, gloss, biodegradable, etc.) 🔹 Strong understanding of retail & wholesale packaging trends 🔹 Knowledge of packaging regulations, ingredient listing, and barcode placement 🔹 Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or similar tools 🔹 Ability to deliver print-ready files with dielines & bleed margins Bonus Skills (Nice to Have): ⭐ Experience working with eco-friendly or compostable packaging materials ⭐ Understanding of supermarket and grocery store shelf display trends ⭐ Knowledge of packaging suppliers & cost-effective printing solutions Deliverables: 📌 Final pouch design in AI, PDF, and PNG formats 📌 3D mockups for presentation & marketing 📌 Print-ready files with dielines and necessary specifications 📌 Editable source files for future modifications Project Timeline & Budget: ⏳ Expected Completion: 2-3 weeks 💰 Budget: Open to proposals – please include your pricing in your bid How to Apply: 📌 Please submit: ✅ Your portfolio showcasing food packaging designs ✅ A brief proposal outlining your approach and timeline ✅ Any previous work with pouch bags or food products ✅ Your pricing and availability We are excited to work with a talented designer to bring our Panela Sugar packaging to life! 🎨✨ Looking forward to your proposals! 🚀

pastJobsText.title: Food Labeling Consultant for Panela Sugar Package Review (FDA Compliance)
pastJobsText.description: I need a consultant with expertise in FDA food labeling regulations to review the text for my Panela Sugar packaging. The product is unrefined cane sugar targeting U.S. grocery chains like Whole Foods, El Super, Superior Grocers, Cardenas market, Super King, and etc. Your task is to: Ensure the text meets FDA requirements (Nutrition Facts, ingredients, etc.). Confirm it’s suitable for retail acceptance (clear, marketable, UPC-ready). Suggest tweaks if needed for compliance or appeal. 1-2 hour consult (call) Confirmation of FDA compliance. Brief recommendations for improvement (if any). Requirements: Proven experience with FDA food labeling for retail products. U.S.-based and familiar with U.S. regulations. Quick turnaround (within 2-3 days). Budget: (flexible based on experience). Please include: A brief note on your relevant experience and a sample of past work (if available).
